abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: Tesseract Device
abilities.description: Every second Basic Attack On-Hit against Heroes & Monsters grants Boris a Canister for 5s, up to a maximum of 4. Each Canister grants Boris 7.0/10.0/13.0/16.0% Attack Speed and 1.0/1.3/1.5/1.8/2.0/2.3/2.5/2.8/3.0/3.3/3.5/3.8/4.0/4.3/4.5/4.8/5.0/5.3 (+2% physical power)(+0.25 per Level) Healing On-Hit. At max Canisters, Boris unleashes his Tesseract Core. The Core zaps Enemies On-Hit, dealing 5.0/7.0/9.0/11.0/13.0/15.0/17.0/19.0/21.0/23.0/25.0/27.0/29.0/31.0/33.0/35.0/37.0/39.0 (+10% physical power)(+12% magical power)(+2 per Level) magical damage and Healing Boris for 4.0/5.0/6.0/7.0/8.0/9.0/10.0/11.0/12.0/13.0/14.0/15.0/16.0/17.0/18.0/19.0/20.0/21.0 (+10% physical power)(+1 per Level), reduced to 20% effectiveness against Non-Heroes.

abilities.name: Detection Protocol
abilities.description: Boris sniffs the air, Marking a nearby Enemy Hero and generating a Scent Trail to their location for 8s. While moving along the Trail, Boris gains 45.0/55.0/65.0/75.0/85.0% (+15% magical power) Movement Speed. Dealing Hero Damage to the Marked Target consumes the Mark, ending the Trail effect, Slowing the Target by 35% for 1.25s and granting Boris 1 Canister. If no Hero is found, 40% of the Cooldown is refunded.

abilities.name: Primeval Roar
abilities.description: Boris generates a defensive Barrier, granting him 20.0/22.5/25.0/27.5/30.0% Damage Reduction for 2.5s. After the duration, Boris roars, exploding the Barrier and dealing 40.0/55.0/70.0/85.0/100.0 (+30% physical power)(+70% magical power) magical damage to all nearby Enemies. Enemies hit are Feared for 0.5-1s, based on Barrier duration. Boris may manually detonate the Barrier after 0.5s.

abilities.name: Chrono Swipe
abilities.description: Boris dashes forward, swiping all Enemies in his path twice. Each hit deals 20.0/30.0/40.0/50.0/60.0 (+44.0/48.0/52.0/56.0/60.0% physical power) physical damage and applies On-Hit effects.

abilities.name: Ursine Burst
abilities.description: Boris hovers momentarily, before Dashing forward and grabbing the first Enemy Hero he collides with. Boris then leaps into the air with the grabbed Hero and slams them to the ground. All Enemies in the landing zone take 250.0/350.0/450.0 (+160% physical power) (+30.0/45.0/60.0% Target's Bonus Health) physical damage and are Slowed by 75% for 1.25s.

augments.name: Bolster Bearicade
augments.description: While Tesseract Core is active, gain 15% increased Armors.

augments.name: Savage Shred
augments.description: Detection Protocol's Mark Shreds 35% Physical Armor for 5s when consumed.

augments.name: Apex Hunter
augments.description: Chrono Swipe deals 70% more damage to Heroes below 20% Max Health.
